# `aitbc update`

Pull the latest code from git and run the deployment update script.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc update [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--remote` | text | `origin` | no | Git remote to pull from (default: origin) |
| `--branch` | text | `main` | no | Branch to update to (default: main) |
| `--no-deploy` | flag | `false` | no | Fetch and report only; do not pull or run update.sh |
| `--check` | flag | `false` | no | Fetch and report current vs remote SHA without changing anything |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc update
aitbc update --output json
```
